notes:
{絨毯|じゅうたん} refers to thick woven floor coverings, typically wall-to-wall carpets or large decorative rugs. Also commonly written in katakana as じゅうたん.

Related terms:
- ⟦カーペット→カーペット：24239_kaapetto⟧ (carpet - loanword, more casual)
- ⟦ラグ→ラグ：noentry⟧ (smaller rug)
- ⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧ (mat)
- ⟦{敷物|しきもの}→敷物：17130_shikimono⟧ (general term for floor coverings)
